data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (converter, holidays, mail to ops with the subject and body templates), but it says "Send or discard" when the true workflow must discard and never send. It also hardcodes "ahead" and treats the country as the remote country. It leaves out the Mail tab switch and the To/Body clicks, and it lists time difference and holiday dates as parameters when they are derived values, so an automation would be mostly buildable but risky on the send/discard step.
